The quote that is also the design

Why a network quote from Lemon Network Solutions is a ten page book with drawings, and how it gets made.

A quote is the first thing a client reads about you and usually the ugliest. I wanted ours to be the document an engineer could install from and an owner could sign in one sitting.

So the book has the floor plan with the access points placed, the WiFi coverage map, the cameras and doors, the rack elevation, the cabling plan, every product with its photo and list price, the services with a week by week timeline, and the signature lines.

The planner on the site collects the facts, the design is drawn on the real floor plans, the images are captured by script, and the book renders to a US Letter PDF. Every number is checked twice. Then I read every page as if I were the client.
